summary: Maria Blakley, 18, of Dinosaur, found deceased at the scene of a single-vehicle crash on Harpers Corner Road in Dinosaur National Monument (~3 mi north of Hwy 40); last seen ~9 p.m. June 29, a passerby reported the vehicle off the road ~7 a.m. June 30; Artesia Fire Department first on scene; National Park Service and Colorado State Patrol jointly investigated; the road was closed until 1 p.m.
location: Harpers Corner Road (~3 mi north of Hwy 40), Dinosaur National Monument
responding_agency: Artesia Fire Department; National Park Service; Colorado State Patrol
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE — vehicle found Saturday morning; crash occurred overnight 2018-06-29/30. First Moffat County 2018 row in the index. Scope: road-vehicle fatality with documented multi-agency response (fire + NPS + CSP) per ids 3262/3475/2393/3357/3338 precedent.
